description: Questions a reviewer might ask about a setting in the design, each with the passages in OpenTitan's hand-written documentation that answer it.

groups.case: Taken from the statements in reference cases 001 to 003.
groups.renamed: The question uses the register or field name defined in the design; the passage that answers it uses an older or different name.
groups.general: Questions about reset values, defaults and configuration in other modules.

queries.question: In pinmux, what does an MIO pad output after reset if software has not programmed its MIO_OUTSEL register?

targets.quote: all MIO outputs are high-Z
The global default at reset is `2`

queries.question: What sleep behavior does a pinmux pad have after reset when its MIO_PAD_SLEEP_EN bit is not set?

targets.quote: Drive (default)

queries.question: After reset, is reading and halting the csrng internal state enabled for every application instance, as set by INT_STATE_READ_ENABLE and INT_STATE_HALT_ENABLE?

targets.quote: After reset, reading, writing and halting are enabled for all instances.

queries.question: What must be true before csrng accepts a write to INT_STATE_VAL that restores a saved instance state?

targets.quote: Restoring a state by writing
Writing requires

queries.source: documentation names IO_MEASURE_CTRL; the design defines IO_MEAS_CTRL_EN and IO_MEAS_CTRL_SHADOWED
queries.question: What does setting IO_MEAS_CTRL_EN in clkmgr turn on?

targets.quote: measurement control registers such as

queries.source: documentation names HW_CFG_DIGEST_0; the design defines HW_CFG0_DIGEST_0 and HW_CFG1_DIGEST_0
queries.question: When does the otp_ctrl HW_CFG0_DIGEST_0 register show the digest after software locks the HW_CFG0 partition?

targets.quote: Perform a full-system reset and verify

queries.source: documentation names PERIPH_INSEL_0; the design defines MIO_PERIPH_INSEL_0
queries.question: Which input does a peripheral see after reset if MIO_PERIPH_INSEL has not been programmed?

targets.quote: all MIO peripheral inputs are tied off to 0

queries.source: spi_device; the README names the register FILTER, the theory of operation uses the design's name CMD_FILTER
queries.question: In spi_device passthrough mode, what happens to a command whose opcode bit is set in CMD_FILTER?

targets.quote: filter prohibited commands
filters a command by de-asserting CSb

queries.source: documentation names COM_DET_SEL_CTL_0; the design defines COM_PRE_DET_CTL_0
queries.question: What does sysrst_ctrl COM_PRE_DET_CTL configure for a key combo?

targets.quote: The key-pressed time for the pre-condition

queries.source: documentation names TARG_QUEUE_THLD_CTRL.TX_DESC_THLD; the design defines TARG_QUEUE_THLD_CTRL.RX_DESC_THLD
queries.question: In the i3c target transaction interface, what interrupt does TARG_QUEUE_THLD_CTRL.RX_DESC_THLD control?

targets.quote: threshold-driven interrupt for the number of descriptors in the Rx Queue

queries.question: After the AES block comes out of reset, do the key, IV and data registers still hold their reset values?

targets.quote: can no longer be expected to match the reset values
cleared with pseudo-random data upon reset

queries.question: Which SPI_HOST interrupts are enabled after reset if software leaves ERROR_ENABLE and EVENT_ENABLE unchanged?

targets.quote: At reset all fields in `ERROR_ENABLE` are set
By default none of these SPI events trigger an interrupt.
By default all error events will trigger an `error` interrupt.

queries.question: What is the default minimum time chip select stays high between SPI_HOST transactions, and which CONFIGOPTS field extends it?

targets.quote: CONFIGOPTS.CSNIDLE

queries.question: Which mode does entropy_src start in after reset, and how large is the health-test window in that mode?

targets.quote: start up in boot-time / bypass mode by default

queries.question: Which EDN request mode is active after reset before software configures the block?

targets.quote: boot-time request mode is the default mode

queries.question: What happens in EDN auto request mode if MAX_NUM_REQS_BETWEEN_RESEEDS is left at its reset value?

targets.quote: The reset value is `0`, which means no `generate` commands are issued.

queries.question: Can software start an OTBN operation immediately after reset, and what does the STATUS register show at that time?

targets.quote: After reset (*init*), OTBN performs a secure wipe
BUSY_SEC_WIPE_INT
The secure wipe after reset must succeed before OTBN can be used.

queries.question: Is the SRAM scrambling key random right after reset, and what should boot software do about it?

targets.quote: the scrambling key defaults to a predefined value
predefined scrambling key and nonce

queries.question: What level does the sysrst_ctrl flash write-protect output have after reset, and how does software release it?

targets.quote: This output is always asserted when the `sysrst_ctrl` block is reset
Upon reset, the `flash_wp_l_o` signal will be asserted active low.

queries.question: Can the alert handler escalate on an alert during power-up, before firmware has configured it?

targets.quote: the alerts are disabled by default

queries.question: Does the PLIC forward a pending interrupt to the CPU right after reset if software has not configured it?

targets.quote: all priorities and thresholds are 0 by default

queries.question: Which life cycle state does lc_ctrl assume at power-up, before the OTP life cycle partition has been read?

targets.quote: default to "RAW" state

queries.question: Can the CPU execute code from RRAM after reset, and how does software enable it?

targets.quote: Instruction fetches via the host TL-UL port are disabled by default.

queries.question: What level does a PWM output have when its channel is disabled, and can the polarity be changed?

targets.quote: the output is low if a PWM channel is disabled

queries.question: What byte order does HMAC use for the key registers by default, and how is it changed?

targets.quote: big-endian by default

queries.question: By default, what level do the pattgen pcl and pda outputs have while a channel is disabled?

targets.quote: outputs are zero when pattgen is inactive

queries.question: Which rstmgr register tells software why the chip was last reset?

targets.quote: indicates why the system was reset
